carousels.name: 3 reasons p*rn feels better than real life, and why it isn't

slides.title: 3 reasons p*rn feels better [[than real life]] — and why it isn't.
slides.sub: The trick is in how it's built.

slides.title: Zero [[effort]]
slides.body: Real connection takes time, words and risk. P*rn takes a tap. Easy feels good now. Effort feels good later.

slides.title: Endless [[new]]
slides.body: Real life repeats. P*rn never runs out of "new." Your brain loves novelty — and it's being farmed.

slides.title: No [[rejection]]
slides.body: P*rn can't say no, judge you or leave. But it can't love you, know you or stay either.

slides.title: Choose [[real]]
items: Find novelty offline — a new route, place or skill.
Remember: p*rn feels good, then leaves you worse.
slides.note: Save this for when real life feels boring 🔖

slides.title:
Choose real life.

slides.sub: 7 days left. Be honest with yourself first.

slides.title: [[Shame]]

slides.title: Reasons [[3–4]]
